## Summary

Repo: DontPanic

Implemented F001 by adding `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/operator_console.py` — the shared `ActionItem` envelope, the four-band `Band` taxonomy (`needs_action`/`advisory`/`info`/`ready`), and five pure providers that map gate state, capability status, reconcile drift, active supervisors, and architecture snapshot freshness into ActionItems. The module also ships `aggregate()` (deterministic merge with dedup), `render_envelope()`/`render_json()` (stable sort_keys output), and `write_cache()` writing `~/.dontpanic/dashboard/what-now.json` at mode 0o600, anchored via `global_config.dontpanic_home()` so it honors `$DONTPANIC_HOME` for both operators and tests. A no-secret invariant runs the OSS sanitization regexes against every rendered envelope and refuses to emit on match. `ActionItem.__post_init__` enforces source/band typing and the `automatable` ↔ `human_required_reason` contract.

Tests landed in `scripts/dontpanic_orchestrate/tests/test_operator_console_f001.py` — 24 cases covering each band mapping, deterministic cross-source ordering, empty-state stable envelope, id-based dedup, the no-secret invariant, cache file mode + idempotence, and the ActionItem invariants. Targeted run is green (24 passed, 0.12s), and a regression check against the modules I import (`sanitization_check`, `capabilities_status`) is also green (29 passed). I did not flip `features.json` F001 to `passes: true`
